primary_claim: Across three secret-keeping LLM settings (secret word, secret instruction, user gender), black-box elicitation methods based on prefilling assistant responses and sampling from the assistant/user persona are the most effective at eliciting an LLM's undisclosed secret knowledge in two of three settings, while mechanistic-interpretability (white-box) methods based on the logit lens and SAEs improve auditor performance over a simple baseline across all settings.

effect.metric: auditor LLM guessing success at secret elicitation, across 3 settings and multiple methods

quote: In 2/3 of our settings, the best performers were black-box strategies based on prefilling assistant responses and sampling either from the assistant or user persona.
